name: angular-code-quality-toolkit
description: VS Code extension to run Angular code-quality tools (depcheck, ts-prune, ESLint, stylelint), add ESLint to Angular projects, and help clean unused code, dependencies, and styles.

virtualWorkspaces.description: This extension runs command-line tools (depcheck, ts-prune, ESLint, stylelint) in your workspace, which requires a real filesystem. It is unavailable in virtual workspaces such as VS Code for the Web (vscode.dev / github.dev).

commands.title: Angular Code Quality: Add ESLint to Angular project
Angular Code Quality: Run knip (unused files, exports, dependencies)
Angular Code Quality: Lint Angular templates (.html)
Angular Code Quality: Find circular dependencies (madge)
Angular Code Quality: Fix ESLint problems (--fix)
Angular Code Quality: Fix stylelint problems (--fix)
Angular Code Quality: Run all checks
Angular Code Quality: Select Angular project
Angular Code Quality: Remove unused dependency
Angular Code Quality: Remove export keyword

angularCodeQuality.packageManager.description: Package manager used to run tools and scripts. "auto" detects it from the lockfile in the workspace root (pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lockb, package-lock.json).

angularCodeQuality.tsPrune.tsconfigPath.description: Path (relative to the workspace root) to the tsconfig ts-prune should use. Falls back to running ts-prune without a project file if the file is missing.

angularCodeQuality.stylelint.globs.description: Glob patterns stylelint should lint when no "lint:styles" or "stylelint" npm script is defined.

angularCodeQuality.template.globs.description: Glob patterns for "Lint Angular templates" (runs ESLint over your .html templates via @angular-eslint/template). In a multi-project workspace, this defaults to the selected project's source root unless set explicitly.

angularCodeQuality.eslint.useJsonFormat.description: Request JSON output from the lint script (npm run lint -- --format json) for more reliable parsing. Disable if your lint script does not support --format.

angularCodeQuality.stylelint.useJsonForm.description: Request JSON output from stylelint (--formatter json) for more reliable parsing. Disable if your setup does not support it.

angularCodeQuality.depcheck.ignoreAngula.description: Hide depcheck "unused dependency" results for packages Angular uses implicitly (@angular/*, zone.js, rxjs, tslib, typescript, karma/jasmine, and builders referenced in angular.json), which are otherwise false positives.

angularCodeQuality.depcheck.ignores.description: Additional package-name patterns to hide from depcheck "unused dependency" results. "*" is a wildcard (e.g. "@my-scope/*").

angularCodeQuality.revealOutputOnRun.description: Reveal the Angular Code Quality output channel automatically each time a command runs. Findings appear in the Problems panel; enable this only if you want to watch the raw tool logs.

angularCodeQuality.runOnSave.description: Automatically re-run the relevant checks when you save a file, updating the Problems panel in the background (no notifications). Saving a .ts file re-runs ESLint and ts-prune; a .html file re-runs the Angular template lint; a .css/.scss file re-runs stylelint; package.json re-runs depcheck. Runs are debounced so rapid saves trigger a single run.

angularCodeQuality.runOnActivation.description: Automatically run all checks once when the workspace opens, so the Problems panel is populated without running a command by hand. Runs quietly in the background (a status-bar spinner, no popups). Off by default.

scripts.pretest:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests
